title: CouponsCouponDisabledPayload
description: coupons.coupon.disabled v1 (OpenVibe.Coupons server/domain/coupons.js recompute via withdrawSourceItem and setStatus, payload from lifecyclePayload). A code was taken down, in the transaction that recorded it: the last OpenVibe.Sources item that evidenced it was removed at the source (reason source_removed), or staff or a service holding coupons.status.update disabled it (staff, service:<client>[:<note>]). Its page answers 410, it cannot be resubmitted and nothing is deleted. Disabling a merchant does not emit this per code (its codes only get Search tombstones). When the code was in Search, a coupons.index_document.deleted tombstone follows in the same transaction. Envelope: subject { type: coupon, id: cpn_… }, visibility public when the code was publicly listed before the change, otherwise internal, priority important (not set: the Events default), actor service:coupons. No known consumers.

merchant_id.description: The merchant the code belongs to.

confidence.description: Report confidence at the time (rounded to 2 decimals); null = no counted report in the last 30 days.

canonical_url.description: The code's page on Coupons (<origin>/c/<coupon id>); it now answers 410.

anyOf.description: service:<client id>, plus :<note> (at most 200 characters, copied verbatim) when the service gave one.
